changes_made: Added import: from django.views.decorators.cache import cache_page
Added @cache_page(300) decorator to dashboard_materials view function
file_insights.impact: Performance optimization - added HTTP cache header to dashboard view with 300-second TTL

patterns_discovered.description: Using Django's @cache_page decorator to cache HTTP responses at the view level
patterns_discovered.context: Applied to dashboard_materials view with 300-second cache duration

patterns_discovered.description: Combining @cache_page with @login_required decorators on same view
patterns_discovered.context: @cache_page(300) placed above @login_required - decorator order matters in Django for cache behavior

gotchas_discovered.description: @cache_page should be placed ABOVE other decorators like @login_required to properly cache authenticated views. If placed below, authentication check happens before caching, potentially causing unexpected behavior.
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Verify decorator order and ensure cache applies to the intended audience

gotchas_discovered.description: Using @cache_page on login_required views can cause the same cached response to be served to different users if cache keys don't account for user identity
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Consider using cache_control with vary_on_headers or implementing user-aware cache keys

approach_outcome.task_description: Add cache_page(300) to materials dashboard_materials view
approach_outcome.implementation_method: Direct decorator addition with proper import statement

recommendations.recommendation: Verify that cached dashboard content is appropriate for all users - consider if user-specific data exists in the dashboard that shouldn't be shared across sessions
Add explanatory comment above @cache_page(300) explaining why 300 seconds was chosen and what data is cached
Add tests to verify cache behavior works correctly with the @login_required decorator and that cache invalidation strategy is sound
Document the caching strategy for the materials dashboard module, including cache TTL and any cache invalidation triggers
